name: job-monitor
description: Frontend-only GitHub Actions PR & workflow dashboard
//workspaces: The telemetry wire schema is a contract between the desktop client and the ingest receiver; both live here so one PR can change the proto, both ends and both test suites. server/** and packages/** are excluded from the Pages and desktop workflows.

scripts.//dev: Three applications live here; the flag chooses. `npm run dev -- --help` lists them.
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:telemetry
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:schema
scripts.electron:dev: npm run check-node && npm run build && npm run icons && electron .
scripts.electron:dist: npm run check-node && npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder
scripts.electron:publish: npm run check-node && npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --publish always
